summary: Official Egyptian General Survey Authority sources establish a national survey/cadastral-map custodian and related map procedures, but no Sers Al Layyan-specific public parcel service or safe anonymous parcel ID plus polygon response was verified.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery queries are recorded in city-3511-sers-al-layyan.json. They identified ESA official map/service pages, the official Ministry of Justice portal, the Egyptian Tax Authority local-coverage page, and the IDSC ArcGIS directory; general national material was distinguished from local cadastral evidence.
requestOutcomes: ESA homepage, services page, and current directorate/map page returned HTTP 200. The ESA map page resolved to a static directorate image map plus Google Maps script, not a parcel API. The IDSC ArcGIS service directory returned HTTP 200 but exposed no clearly identified public cadastral/parcel layer in the bounded review. The ETA page returned HTTP 200 but is tax-administration evidence only. No login, credentials, private token, owner/name/address/titleholder/contact/tax-account lookup, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, or formal submission was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [30.4530031406614, 30.9429228461777] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no exact-point hit or miss was inferred.
National ESA mandate and general service descriptions are not proof of an open Sers Al Layyan parcel layer or citywide coverage.
The IDSC service-directory review was bounded by service-name inspection; absence of a clear parcel service there is not evidence of cadastral absence.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema, CRS, or bounded parcel extent was retrieved or retained.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion records executed research only; it does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter. Serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
